area: Flower Street at Lincoln Street, Bakersfield
disposition: report taken; suspect description passed to officers
summary: A caller reported an assault with a baseball bat that had happened at Flower Street and Lincoln Street. The caller was waiting for officers nearby, and a suspect description was broadcast: a man in a black shirt and blue pants.

disposition: deputies checking the area; location came from a phone ping
summary: A woman told dispatchers her husband had said he planned to kill himself. Deputies were sent to the area east of Bakersfield, and the location was found through a ping on the man's phone.

agency: California Highway Patrol; Kern County Fire Department
disposition: call cancelled; arriving units found no vehicle
summary: A rescue, engine, truck and battalion assignment went out with CHP for a reported rollover on southbound Interstate 5 south of Bakersfield. The first unit on scene reported the vehicle had rolled and then left, and the assignment was cancelled.
A vehicle fire was reported on Mount Vernon Avenue, with a gray SUV burning on the roadway.
Units working the southbound side of Interstate 5 near the Grapevine reported nothing showing and cancelled the vegetation response.
Crews were sent to a home for a report of a gas leak coming from inside, possibly from the stove. The homeowner said they could not turn it off, and the response was cut to a single engine.

disposition: crew returned to clear the roadway
summary: A unit went back to Wilson Road to clear debris out of the roadway.

area: Highways 138 and 14 at the Kern County line
disposition: engine and water tender sent on the request of Los Angeles County
summary: Los Angeles County dispatchers asked Kern units to respond to a grass fire where Highway 138 meets Highway 14, and an engine and a water tender were sent.
A unit was sent to a disturbance at an apartment on the 300 block of Chester Lane.
Deputies and an ambulance were sent for a welfare check at a home on the 2100 block of Coventry Drive.

area: Highway 178 at Alfred Harrell Highway, Bakersfield
summary: Three vehicles pulling jet skis were reported parked in the westbound lanes at Highway 178 and Alfred Harrell Highway.
Officers were sent to assist at a home on the 800 block of 8th Street.
